definition: OptimalThinkingBench's per-threshold overthinking metric: OAA_t counts a response correct only if it also stays under a thinking-token threshold t, so a model that reaches the right answer but keeps generating unnecessary tokens scores lower than one that stops promptly. AUC_OAA (area under the OAA_t curve to t_max=1000) is the summary version. Note: same metric as the archive's separately-tracked 'AUC_OAA' entry -- not merged.

evidence.note: Introduces OptimalThinkingBench, a unified benchmark pairing OverthinkingBench (simple queries) and UnderthinkingBench (hard reasoning/math) with a shared F1 metric, showing that none of 33 evaluated LLMs balances accuracy and thinking-token efficiency.
evidence.title: OptimalThinkingBench: Evaluating Over and Underthinking in LLMs

name: Overthinking-Adjusted Accuracy (OAA)
